author: Codex
features: Use exact blocks[line].all whitelist only. Metadata in feature files is never automatically admitted.

first_comparisons.role: reference constant line rate under common C0 observation link
first_comparisons.target: T0 observed response; annual rate uses common C0 effective exposure
first_comparisons.denominator: C0 scoped effective cost exposure, identical observation link to primary challengers
first_comparisons.training_rows: 2023 inner group folds; temporal candidates frozen before 2024

first_comparisons.target: T0 or reserve stress response divided by chosen exposure

observed_baseline.claim: prediction of observed incurred, not ultimate
observed_baseline.role: separate mechanism diagnostic; not a primary-confirmation comparator with a different observation link

conditional_ultimate.response: T0 for b=1; T0+(b-1)*reserve for b=.75/1.25
conditional_ultimate.validation_observed_prediction: matching effective cost exposure * fitted rate
conditional_ultimate.test_prediction: nominal exposure only; no extra IBNR or reserve addition
conditional_ultimate.qualifier: Direct line-level observation mixture approximates row peril composition; per-peril links retained for later comparison
conditional_ultimate.tail_stresses: only long-tail cost beyond maximum 730-day historical window, 5% or 10%; design sensitivity

tweedie_loss.metric: local unweighted total-unit Tweedie D2 proxy; official scorer code not identified
tweedie_loss.requirement: Strictly positive predictions; verify solver weight normalization and regularization. Poisson count-peril models use n/eN with weight eN.

validation.folds: Use existing persisted partitions; do not reseed or resplit by observed loss
validation.encoders_calibration: fit inside development folds, use cross-fitted development predictions; no held-out 2024 labels for target encoders, calibration, reporting or cost-share estimation
validation.first_run_success: complete finite positive totals, retained OOF predictions, matching observation link, line/global metrics and artifact manifest
validation.selection: Mandatory S2 selection v1 policy. W2-B00 and up to three challengers, common frozen observation link, single registered 2024 batch. No alternative thresholds or public tie-break.
validation.ultimate_truth: Unavailable; compare observed proxy and sensitivity, no independent ultimate accuracy claim
validation.confirmation_2024: Closed until roster/recipes/common artifacts and statistical producer are frozen and gate opening registered; no model scores consulted here. Also requires documented closure of S2-AUD-METRIC-BINDING; hash identity alone is insufficient.

selection_gate_finding.consequence: No verified promotion; close semantic binding and independent metrics reconstruction before 2024 confirmation opening

excluded_default: raw or audit identifiers, fold, group
uncertain high raw capital without quality mask
assumptions: supplied period exposure conditions challenge target; not a forecast of cancellation
report delay and marks stationary within peril and independent of truncation calendar
b=1 case reserve and current recoveries are conditional proxies; sufficiency/development unproved
base zero mass beyond reporting support; unobserved tail sensitivities separate
not a fully prospective historical backtest
